title: 毎日王冠の後に・そして“光”へ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka dominates this battle between multiple years of racers and flies past the finish line like a gust of wind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rather than feel embittered by their loss, El Condor Pasa and Grass Wonder enthusiastically swear to one day overcome Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week is also inspired by the exhilarating race and becomes filled with the motivation to surpass Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka herself swears to work hard to keep the lead against Special Week. She simply can't wait for the autumn Tenno Sho!
